records.title: Sewing Machine Operator
skills: Carry out stitching activities using machine or by hand
Contribute to achieve product quality in stitching operations
Maintain work area and tools
Maintain health, safety and secure work place with Gender and PwD Sensitization
Comply with industry, regulatory, organizational requirements and Greening of Job Roles
Employability Skills
records.description: A Sewing Machine Operator also called a Stitcher or Machinist is an important job-role associated with Apparel sector, Made-Ups and Home Furnishing Industry. The primary responsibility of a machinist is to stitch/ sew fabric panels, fur fabric panels, or synthetic materials to produce apparels or made up with desired quality.
records.certification_body: Apparel, Madeups & HomeFurnishing Sector Skill Council (AMHSSC)

records.title: Assistant Electrician (Domestic cum Industrial)
skills: Acquire the concepts of Basic Electrical
Measure Electrical Parameters (Voltage, Current, Power etc.)
Prepare for Domestic and Industrial Electrical Wiring
Perform Transformer Testing and Maintenance
Power Equipment Testing and Maintenance
Repair and Maintenance of Electrical Machines
Employability Skills
records.description: Learners who attain this qualification are competent to carry out electrical installation, maintenance at domestic and industrial site. Learned candidates are qualified to work as Assistant Electrician. Qualified learner can also start their own electrical workshop or choose to be an entrepreneur.
records.certification_body: MSME Technology Centre, Ministry of Micro Small And Medium Enterprises, New Delhi

records.title: Pulses Cultivator
skills: Select and prepare the site and sow the pulse seeds
Carry out macro and micronutrient management for field crops
Manage weed growth in crop fields
Perform integrated pest and disease management for pulses
Perform irrigation management for field crops
Carry out harvesting, processing and marketing of pulses
Participate in collective farming activities
Follow health and safety guidelines
Employability Skills (30 Hours)
records.description: A Pulses Cultivator undertakes the cultivation of pulses at the farm level. The individual is also responsible for harvesting and marketing the pulses. The person also undertakes integrated pest and disease management, along with weed management as part of the job role.

records.title: Small Poultry Farmer
skills: Prepare and maintain housing for broiler/layer birds
Prepare the poultry shed to receive and manage the chicks/birds
Maintain the supply of feed and water to poultry birds
Maintain health of birds at poultry farm
Carry out collection of eggs and lifting of broiler birds for market
Undertake sanitization and biosecurity measures for the replacement stock
Carry out documentation and record-keeping at a small poultry farm
Ensure safety, hygiene and sanitation of poultry farm
Undertake basic entrepreneurial activities for small enterprise
Engage in collective farming/activity
Employability Skills (60 Hours)
records.description: A Small Poultry Farmer is responsible for raising different types of domestic birds for the purpose of egg and/or meat production. The person takes various decisions for the viability and sustainability of the poultry farm. The individual ensures proper care of the poultry birds, their health and productivity, meat and/or egg production and marketing of the produce

records.title: Quality Seed Grower
skills: Prepare for growing the seeds
Sow the seeds and maintain the seed crop
Perform harvesting and post-harvest processing of the seed crop
Undertake basic entrepreneurial activities for small Enterprise
Maintain health and safety at the workplace
Employability Skills (60 Hours)
records.description: A Quality Seed Grower produces a variety of high-quality seed crops under the supervision of a field supervisor from the seed production company. The person is responsible for preparing the field, sowing, maintaining, harvesting and performing post-harvest processing of the foundation and certified seeds as per the instructions of the seed production company.

records.title: Organic Grower
skills: Undertake planning for organic farming
Carry out seed selection and treatment under organic farming
Carry out soil nutrient management under organic farming
Carry out weed management in an organic farm
Carry out irrigation management in an organic farm
Integrated pest and disease management in an organic farm
Carry out harvest and post-harvest management in an organic farm
Undertake quality assurance and certification in organic farming
Undertake business of organic farming
Maintain health and safety at the workplace
Employability Skills (60 Hours)
records.description: The job of an organic grower involves cultivation of organic crops as per the organic package of practices recommended for a particular agro climate zone, using approaches like diversity, cattle integration, on- farm input generation, biomass recycling, natural resource use optimization in exclusion of synthetic inputs directly or indirectly and sell the organic produce as per the competitive market prices without distress sale.

records.title: Paddy Cultivator
skills: Seed Preparation in Paddy
Land preparation and transplantation in Paddy
Integrated Nutrient Management in Paddy
Weed Management in Paddy
Integrated Pest and Disease Management in Paddy
Irrigation Management in Paddy
Harvesting and Post-Harvest Management in Paddy
Maintain health and safety at the workplace
Employability Skills (30 Hours)
records.description: The job of a paddy cultivator involves cultivation of paddy as per the package of practices recommended for a particular agronomic climate zone, type of soil, rainfall pattern and climatic conditions to achieve the yields as per the genetic potential of a given variety and sell the produce as per the competitive market prices without distress sale.
